channel.title: ShopNow Kitchen Edit — Guides
channel.description: Question-shaped buying guides for air fryers and multi-function kitchen appliances. Reader-supported; every pick carries its sourcing. This surface complements the canonical root publication.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: The real differences between basket air fryers and oven-style air fryers: timing, capacity shape, cleanup, counter space and the questions to ask before you pick a side.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts lie a little. Compare capacity by portions per basket, shape, and what you actually cook — without trusting the big number on the box.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs no spec sheet leads with: what you'll wash, and what you'll give up on the counter.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: The questions that separate appliances you'll use weekly from appliances you'll store in the garage.
